description: Email the buyer a new confirmation code when the first did not arrive or expired (30 minutes). Use it only after place_order, when the buyer says no email came (after 10 minutes and a spam check) or the code expired; do not use it to confirm (confirm_order). Needs order_number and order_secret from place_order. At most 2 resends per order request; the old code stops working. Returns status: sent, already (confirmed, nothing to resend), invalid, limit, locked, expired (place a new order request); resends_left and a message.

order_number.description: order_number from the place_order reply: a positive integer, e.g. 1042.

order_secret.description: order_secret from the place_order reply: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Pass it exactly as received; it is shown only in that reply, so keep it for this conversation.

name: resend_code
title: Email a new confirmation code
